headline: Vale Indonesia (INCO) Reshuffles Board of Directors and Commissioners, Check the Latest Lineup
summary: Vale Indonesia changed its board of commissioners and directors at an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders. The reshuffle details were reported by CNBC Indonesia.
why: Vale Indonesia is a listed nickel producer in Sulawesi, and board changes can signal shifts in strategy and governance.
original_headline: Vale Indonesia (INCO) Rombak Direksi dan Komisaris, Cek Susunan Terbaru
